description: This Java class 'ContentUrlTag' provides utility methods to generate content URLs with appropriate prefixes based on security context and website configuration, primarily used for constructing URLs with content prefixes from properties or website settings.

classes.name: ContentUrlTag
classes.description: Utility class for appending content URL prefixes based on request context and website configuration.

methods.name: appendContentPrefix
methods.description: Appends the appropriate content prefix to a StringBuilder or Appendable based on the request's security context and website settings.

methods.name: getContentPrefix
methods.description: Returns the content URL prefix as a String based on the request context.
